name: TradingView-Style Technical Analysis - SLV
description: Technical analysis dashboard for Silver ETF (SLV) with oscillators, moving averages, and pivot points. Inspired by TradingView's Technicals view.
source:
# =============================================================================
# TRADINGVIEW-STYLE TECHNICAL ANALYSIS DASHBOARD
# Asset: SLV (Silver ETF)
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# DATA SOURCE
# =============================================================================

data = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = data.c
high = data.h
low = data.l
volume = data.v

# =============================================================================
# OSCILLATORS (using requiredDataSources - no inputs needed)
# =============================================================================

# RSI (14) - takes input
rsi_14 = rsi(period=14)(close)

# Stochastic %K (14, 3, 3) - uses PriceBars internally
stoch_result = stoch(k_period=14, k_slowing_period=3, d_period=3)()
stoch_k = stoch_result.stoch_k
stoch_d = stoch_result.stoch_d

# CCI (20) - uses PriceBars internally
cci_20 = cci(period=20)()

# ADX (14) and DI - use PriceBars internally
adx_14 = adx(period=14)()
di_result = di(period=14)()
plus_di = di_result.plus_di
minus_di = di_result.minus_di

# Awesome Oscillator - uses PriceBars internally
ao_result = ao()()

# Momentum (10) - takes input
mom_10 = mom(period=10)(close)

# MACD (12, 26, 9) - takes input
macd_result = macd(short_period=12, long_period=26, signal_period=9)(close)
macd_line = macd_result.macd
macd_sig = macd_result.macd_signal
macd_hist = macd_result.macd_histogram

# Williams %R (14) - uses PriceBars internally
willr_14 = willr(period=14)()

# Ultimate Oscillator (7, 14, 28) - uses PriceBars internally
uo_result = ultosc(short_period=7, medium_period=14, long_period=28)()

# =============================================================================
# OSCILLATOR SIGNALS (-1 = Sell, 0 = Neutral, 1 = Buy)
# =============================================================================

# RSI: <30 = Buy, >70 = Sell, else Neutral
rsi_signal = 1 if rsi_14 < 30 else -1 if rsi_14 > 70 else 0

# Stochastic: <20 = Buy, >80 = Sell, else Neutral
stoch_signal = 1 if stoch_k < 20 else -1 if stoch_k > 80 else 0

# CCI: <-100 = Buy, >100 = Sell, else Neutral
cci_signal = 1 if cci_20 < -100 else -1 if cci_20 > 100 else 0

# ADX: +DI > -DI = Buy, +DI < -DI = Sell (only if ADX > 20)
adx_signal = 0 if adx_14 < 20 else 1 if plus_di > minus_di else -1

# AO: >0 = Buy, <0 = Sell
ao_signal = 1 if ao_result > 0 else -1 if ao_result < 0 else 0

# Momentum: >0 = Buy, <0 = Sell
mom_signal = 1 if mom_10 > 0 else -1 if mom_10 < 0 else 0

# MACD: histogram >0 = Buy, <0 = Sell
macd_signal_ind = 1 if macd_hist > 0 else -1 if macd_hist < 0 else 0

# Williams %R: >-20 = Sell, <-80 = Buy
willr_signal = 1 if willr_14 < -80 else -1 if willr_14 > -20 else 0

# Ultimate Oscillator: <30 = Buy, >70 = Sell
uo_signal = 1 if uo_result < 30 else -1 if uo_result > 70 else 0

# =============================================================================
# MOVING AVERAGES (ma transform takes input)
# =============================================================================

# Simple Moving Averages
sma_10 = ma(period=10, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_20 = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_30 = ma(period=30, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_50 = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_100 = ma(period=100, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_200 = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# Exponential Moving Averages
ema_10 = ma(period=10, type=MAType.ema)(close)
ema_20 = ma(period=20, type=MAType.ema)(close)
ema_30 = ma(period=30, type=MAType.ema)(close)
ema_50 = ma(period=50, type=MAType.ema)(close)
ema_100 = ma(period=100, type=MAType.ema)(close)
ema_200 = ma(period=200, type=MAType.ema)(close)

# Hull Moving Average (9)
hma_9 = ma(period=9, type=MAType.hma)(close)

# VWMA (20) - uses PriceBars internally
vwma_20 = vwma(period=20)()

# Ichimoku Base Line (Kijun-sen) - uses PriceBars internally
ichimoku_result = ichimoku(p_tenkan=9, p_kijun=26, p_senkou_b=52)()
ichimoku_base = ichimoku_result.kijun

# =============================================================================
# MOVING AVERAGE SIGNALS (-1 = Sell, 0 = Neutral, 1 = Buy)
# Price above MA = Buy, Price below MA = Sell
# =============================================================================

sma_10_signal = 1 if close > sma_10 else -1 if close < sma_10 else 0
sma_20_signal = 1 if close > sma_20 else -1 if close < sma_20 else 0
sma_30_signal = 1 if close > sma_30 else -1 if close < sma_30 else 0
sma_50_signal = 1 if close > sma_50 else -1 if close < sma_50 else 0
sma_100_signal = 1 if close > sma_100 else -1 if close < sma_100 else 0
sma_200_signal = 1 if close > sma_200 else -1 if close < sma_200 else 0

ema_10_signal = 1 if close > ema_10 else -1 if close < ema_10 else 0
ema_20_signal = 1 if close > ema_20 else -1 if close < ema_20 else 0
ema_30_signal = 1 if close > ema_30 else -1 if close < ema_30 else 0
ema_50_signal = 1 if close > ema_50 else -1 if close < ema_50 else 0
ema_100_signal = 1 if close > ema_100 else -1 if close < ema_100 else 0
ema_200_signal = 1 if close > ema_200 else -1 if close < ema_200 else 0

hma_signal = 1 if close > hma_9 else -1 if close < hma_9 else 0
vwma_signal = 1 if close > vwma_20 else -1 if close < vwma_20 else 0
ichimoku_signal = 1 if close > ichimoku_base else -1 if close < ichimoku_base else 0

# =============================================================================
# AGGREGATE SCORES
# =============================================================================

# Oscillator counts (9 oscillators)
osc_buy_count = (rsi_signal == 1) + (stoch_signal == 1) + (cci_signal == 1) + (adx_signal == 1) + (ao_signal == 1) + (mom_signal == 1) + (macd_signal_ind == 1) + (willr_signal == 1) + (uo_signal == 1)
osc_sell_count = (rsi_signal == -1) + (stoch_signal == -1) + (cci_signal == -1) + (adx_signal == -1) + (ao_signal == -1) + (mom_signal == -1) + (macd_signal_ind == -1) + (willr_signal == -1) + (uo_signal == -1)
osc_neutral_count = 9 - osc_buy_count - osc_sell_count

# Moving Average counts (15 MAs total)
ma_buy_count = (sma_10_signal == 1) + (sma_20_signal == 1) + (sma_30_signal == 1) + (sma_50_signal == 1) + (sma_100_signal == 1) + (sma_200_signal == 1) + (ema_10_signal == 1) + (ema_20_signal == 1) + (ema_30_signal == 1) + (ema_50_signal == 1) + (ema_100_signal == 1) + (ema_200_signal == 1) + (hma_signal == 1) + (vwma_signal == 1) + (ichimoku_signal == 1)
ma_sell_count = (sma_10_signal == -1) + (sma_20_signal == -1) + (sma_30_signal == -1) + (sma_50_signal == -1) + (sma_100_signal == -1) + (sma_200_signal == -1) + (ema_10_signal == -1) + (ema_20_signal == -1) + (ema_30_signal == -1) + (ema_50_signal == -1) + (ema_100_signal == -1) + (ema_200_signal == -1) + (hma_signal == -1) + (vwma_signal == -1) + (ichimoku_signal == -1)
ma_neutral_count = 15 - ma_buy_count - ma_sell_count

# Total counts (24 indicators)
total_buy = osc_buy_count + ma_buy_count
total_sell = osc_sell_count + ma_sell_count
total_neutral = osc_neutral_count + ma_neutral_count

# Score: -1 (Strong Sell) to +1 (Strong Buy)
osc_score = (osc_buy_count - osc_sell_count) / 9
ma_score = (ma_buy_count - ma_sell_count) / 15
total_score = (total_buy - total_sell) / 24

# Convert to 0-100 scale for gauge (0=Strong Sell, 50=Neutral, 100=Strong Buy)
osc_gauge_value = (osc_score + 1) / 2 * 100
ma_gauge_value = (ma_score + 1) / 2 * 100
summary_gauge_value = (total_score + 1) / 2 * 100

# =============================================================================
# PIVOT POINTS - Using pivot_point_sr() transform
# =============================================================================

# Classic Pivot Points from transform
pivot_out = pivot_point_sr()()
pivot_p = pivot_out.pivot
pivot_r1 = pivot_out.resist_1
pivot_r2 = pivot_out.resist_2
pivot_r3 = pivot_out.resist_3
pivot_s1 = pivot_out.support_1
pivot_s2 = pivot_out.support_2
pivot_s3 = pivot_out.support_3

# For Fibonacci/Camarilla/Woodie we need previous high/low
prev_hl = previous_high_low(interval=1, type=SessionTimeframe.day)()
prev_high = prev_hl.previous_high
prev_low = prev_hl.previous_low
prev_range = prev_high - prev_low

# Fibonacci Pivot Points (based on Classic pivot)
fib_pivot = pivot_p
fib_r1 = pivot_p + 0.382 * prev_range
fib_s1 = pivot_p - 0.382 * prev_range
fib_r2 = pivot_p + 0.618 * prev_range
fib_s2 = pivot_p - 0.618 * prev_range
fib_r3 = pivot_p + prev_range
fib_s3 = pivot_p - prev_range

# Camarilla Pivot Points (uses close as base)
cam_pivot = pivot_p
cam_r1 = close + 1.1 * prev_range / 12
cam_s1 = close - 1.1 * prev_range / 12
cam_r2 = close + 1.1 * prev_range / 6
cam_s2 = close - 1.1 * prev_range / 6
cam_r3 = close + 1.1 * prev_range / 4
cam_s3 = close - 1.1 * prev_range / 4

# Woodie Pivot Points
woodie_pivot = (prev_high + prev_low + 2 * close) / 4
woodie_r1 = 2 * woodie_pivot - prev_low
woodie_s1 = 2 * woodie_pivot - prev_high
woodie_r2 = woodie_pivot + prev_range
woodie_s2 = woodie_pivot - prev_range

# =============================================================================
# VISUALIZATIONS - SUMMARY GAUGES
# =============================================================================

# Main Summary Gauge
gauge(
    title="Summary",
    category="1. Summary",
    min=0,
    max=100,
    categories=['Strong Sell', 'Sell', 'Neutral', 'Buy', 'Strong Buy'],
    use_traffic_light_colors=True,
    decimal_places=0
)(summary_gauge_value)

# Oscillators Gauge
gauge(
    title="Oscillators",
    category="1. Summary",
    min=0,
    max=100,
    categories=['Strong Sell', 'Sell', 'Neutral', 'Buy', 'Strong Buy'],
    use_traffic_light_colors=True,
    decimal_places=0
)(osc_gauge_value)

# Moving Averages Gauge
gauge(
    title="Moving Averages",
    category="1. Summary",
    min=0,
    max=100,
    categories=['Strong Sell', 'Sell', 'Neutral', 'Buy', 'Strong Buy'],
    use_traffic_light_colors=True,
    decimal_places=0
)(ma_gauge_value)

# =============================================================================
# SIGNAL COUNTS TABLE (under each gauge)
# =============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title="Signal Counts",
        row_size=1,
        col_size=3,
        col_headers=["Sell", "Neutral", "Buy"],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last)
        ]
    ),
    category="1. Summary"
)(total_sell, total_neutral, total_buy)

# =============================================================================
# OSCILLATORS TABLE - TradingView Style (Name | Value | Action)
# =============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title="Oscillators",
        row_size=9,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=["RSI (14)", "Stochastic %K (14,3,3)", "CCI (20)", "ADX (14)", "Awesome Oscillator", "Momentum (10)", "MACD Level (12,26)", "Williams %R (14)", "Ultimate Oscillator (7,14,28)"],
        col_headers=["Value", "Action"],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, grid_color_map={Color.Green: ["POSITIVE"], Color.Red: ["NEGATIVE"]}),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, grid_color_map={Color.Green: ["POSITIVE"], Color.Red: ["NEGATIVE"]}),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, grid_color_map={Color.Green: ["POSITIVE"], Color.Red: ["NEGATIVE"]}),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, grid_color_map={Color.Green: ["POSITIVE"], Color.Red: ["NEGATIVE"]}),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, grid_color_map={Color.Green: ["POSITIVE"], Color.Red: ["NEGATIVE"]}),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=5, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_row=5, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, grid_color_map={Color.Green: ["POSITIVE"], Color.Red: ["NEGATIVE"]}),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=6, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_row=6, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, grid_color_map={Color.Green: ["POSITIVE"], Color.Red: ["NEGATIVE"]}),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=7, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_row=7, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, grid_color_map={Color.Green: ["POSITIVE"], Color.Red: ["NEGATIVE"]}),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=8, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_row=8, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, grid_color_map={Color.Green: ["POSITIVE"], Color.Red: ["NEGATIVE"]})
        ]
    ),
    category="2. Oscillators"
)(rsi_14, rsi_signal, stoch_k, stoch_signal, cci_20, cci_signal, adx_14, adx_signal, ao_result, ao_signal, mom_10, mom_signal, macd_line, macd_signal_ind, willr_14, willr_signal, uo_result, uo_signal)

# =============================================================================
# MOVING AVERAGES TABLE - TradingView Style (Name | Value | Action)
# =============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title="Moving Averages",
        row_size=15,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=["EMA (10)", "SMA (10)", "EMA (20)", "SMA (20)", "EMA (30)", "SMA (30)", "EMA (50)", "SMA (50)", "EMA (100)", "SMA (100)", "EMA (200)", "SMA (200)", "Hull MA (9)", "VWMA (20)", "Ichimoku Base (26)"],
        col_headers=["Value", "Action"],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, grid_color_map={Color.Green: ["POSITIVE"], Color.Red: ["NEGATIVE"]}),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, grid_color_map={Color.Green: ["POSITIVE"], Color.Red: ["NEGATIVE"]}),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, grid_color_map={Color.Green: ["POSITIVE"], Color.Red: ["NEGATIVE"]}),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, grid_color_map={Color.Green: ["POSITIVE"], Color.Red: ["NEGATIVE"]}),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, grid_color_map={Color.Green: ["POSITIVE"], Color.Red: ["NEGATIVE"]}),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=5, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_row=5, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, grid_color_map={Color.Green: ["POSITIVE"], Color.Red: ["NEGATIVE"]}),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=6, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_row=6, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, grid_color_map={Color.Green: ["POSITIVE"], Color.Red: ["NEGATIVE"]}),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=7, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_row=7, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, grid_color_map={Color.Green: ["POSITIVE"], Color.Red: ["NEGATIVE"]}),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=8, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_row=8, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, grid_color_map={Color.Green: ["POSITIVE"], Color.Red: ["NEGATIVE"]}),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=9, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_row=9, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, grid_color_map={Color.Green: ["POSITIVE"], Color.Red: ["NEGATIVE"]}),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=10, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_row=10, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, grid_color_map={Color.Green: ["POSITIVE"], Color.Red: ["NEGATIVE"]}),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=11, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_row=11, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, grid_color_map={Color.Green: ["POSITIVE"], Color.Red: ["NEGATIVE"]}),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=12, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_row=12, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, grid_color_map={Color.Green: ["POSITIVE"], Color.Red: ["NEGATIVE"]}),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=13, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_row=13, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, grid_color_map={Color.Green: ["POSITIVE"], Color.Red: ["NEGATIVE"]}),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=14, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_row=14, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, grid_color_map={Color.Green: ["POSITIVE"], Color.Red: ["NEGATIVE"]})
        ]
    ),
    category="3. Moving Averages"
)(ema_10, ema_10_signal, sma_10, sma_10_signal, ema_20, ema_20_signal, sma_20, sma_20_signal, ema_30, ema_30_signal, sma_30, sma_30_signal, ema_50, ema_50_signal, sma_50, sma_50_signal, ema_100, ema_100_signal, sma_100, sma_100_signal, ema_200, ema_200_signal, sma_200, sma_200_signal, hma_9, hma_signal, vwma_20, vwma_signal, ichimoku_base, ichimoku_signal)

# =============================================================================
# PIVOT POINTS TABLE - TradingView Style (Pivot | Classic | Fibonacci | Camarilla | Woodie)
# =============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title="Pivot Points",
        row_size=7,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=["R3", "R2", "R1", "P", "S1", "S2", "S3"],
        col_headers=["Classic", "Fibonacci", "Camarilla", "Woodie"],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=4, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_row=4, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
